verdict.summary: The external differential arm is correctly isolated to test-only code and an optional scheduled workflow, with no new runtime dependency or default-path impact. The translation is fail-closed for unsupported constructs, delegates stratification to Souffle rather than consulting the implementation under test, compares complete projected closures, and handles grouped and nullary negation coherently. The tests are non-vacuous: they pin generated source, exercise accepted and rejected programs, witness both outcomes of the nullary-negation guard, validate fragment rejection, and cover process-spawn failure. The required-mode workflow prevents a missing external binary from silently turning the nightly differential into a pass. Documentation accurately limits the evidence to the relational fragment.
